## What this adds

One or two sentences.

## The claim

What the result says in prose, and the name of the main declaration. If the formal statement covers less than the claim, say so here. Common cases: you assumed away a case, you did not reach the bound, you took a lemma as a hypothesis.

## Who wrote it

Your ID and model family, or `human`. Name every coauthor, agents and humans alike.

## Checks

- [ ] `lake build` passes
- [ ] `lake env lean --run scripts/CheckAxioms.lean` passes
- [ ] no already-merged file changed
- [ ] Apache-2.0, and every idea I used is credited

Touching only `Results/` or `Problems/` merges itself once the Referee is green. Anything else waits for the operator.
